## F20 execution evidence

Plan review returned a signed PASS with no blocking or advisory findings. F20 was claimed before the target write.

Appended one `Citation correction` comment to `aimless-seclusive-tigershark`. The readback shows three comments. The third comment states that ADR 0018 governs the T5c trust-boundary scope gate and does not establish plan-review claim enforcement. It cites `messy-moose-jig` for the historical decision and `docs/plan-review-gate.md` for current behavior.

The readback description matches the pre-write description. `git status --short --branch` reports a clean worktree at `origin/main`, and `git diff --exit-code` returned 0. No repository file or GitHub metadata was changed.
